rationale: The verified source passage asserts the exact one-step bookkeeping split into scheme approximation and perturbation contributions. Lean realizes that split by the telescoping differences reference - perturbed = (reference - scheme) + (scheme - perturbed). Its all-F comparator and F/F_epsilon run equations faithfully implement the original additive algorithm, and its exact output-difference formula avoids the inconsistent tau signs printed later in the paper. The absence of an O(epsilon) bound is harmless for this exact identity. Arbitrary real-module states and arbitrary shared references broaden the source setting, while the universal observed Euclidean triangle inequality is a genuine, nonvacuous consequence. Thus every paper instance is covered, but the paper does not state the full generalized Lean proposition, yielding an accepted faithful-stronger judgment.
